semiconductor_relevance: High — ONANO specializes in optoelectronic glass thinning and substrate technologies that are critical for semiconductor applications.
summary: ONANO Industrial Corp. is a leading provider of optoelectronic glass thinning services and semiconductor substrate technologies in Taiwan. The company focuses on advanced etching processes and the development of ceramic substrates, including AlN, to support heterogeneous integration in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Optimized etching processes for high aspect ratio glass substrates
Production of AlN substrates with thermal conductivity >170W/mk

regional_presence.Taiwan: ONANO is the first professional optoelectronic glass thinning manufacturing service company established in Taiwan.
